subject: Describe your town and say what you like most about it.
text: I live in a small coastal town in the north of the country. In the morning, fishermen bring their boats back to the harbour and sell fish on the quay, so the whole town smells of the sea. What I like most is the old lighthouse at the end of the pier. From the top, you can see the mountains on one side and the open sea on the other. In summer the streets get crowded with tourists, but in winter the town becomes quiet again, and I enjoy walking along the empty beach with my dog after school. I hope it never changes too much.

subject: Should students wear a school uniform? Give your opinion.
instructions: Give at least two arguments and a conclusion.
text: Many schools require their students to wear a uniform, and this rule often sparks heated debate. In my view, uniforms do more good than harm. First, they reduce visible differences between rich and poor families, so students are judged less by their clothes and more by their behaviour. Second, they save time in the morning: nobody has to decide what to wear, and parents spend less money on fashionable outfits. Admittedly, uniforms limit self-expression, and some students feel uncomfortable in them. However, schools could allow small personal touches, such as badges or scarves. All things considered, I believe uniforms create a fairer and calmer atmosphere for learning.

subject: Should students wear a school uniform? Give your opinion.
instructions: Give at least two arguments and a conclusion.
text: I think students should not wear a uniform. First, the uniform is not comfortable, it is too hot in summer and the colour is ugly. Second, everybody is different and we want to show our personality with our clothes. When I wear my own clothes I feel more confident and I work better. Some people say the uniform is good because it is cheaper, but my parents buy two uniforms every year and it is expensive too. In conclusion, I prefer to choose my clothes, and I think the school must give us this freedom.
